description: We are Soteronautas from Salvador, Brazil. In Challenge #10, we built F.A.R.O.L. (Camada Jev): an explainable tactical decision & route-planning system for Mars EVA astronauts. Fusing real NASA data—THEMIS firmness, HiRISE 1m topography, USGS geology, and Perseverance ground-truth—with astronaut voice across a Helmet HUD, Wrist Cuff, and Mission Console, F.A.R.O.L. turns planetary hazards into safe, transparent A* bypasses, ensuring crew survival and scientific mission success
